messages:
Sam: quick sync — dashboard query refactor caused perf regressions for large-org panels. we need to decide RBAC pushdown vs app-layer filtering. cc @Maria
Maria: can you paste an example slow query / numbers?
Sam: p50 panel render for orgs >1000 users: 60ms -> 220ms after PR #4321. root cause looks like authz filter applied after projection, causing large scan + join.
Lee: DB note — predicate pushdown helps a lot but we might need authz-specific indexes or a materialized join table. that adds write amplification and more infra to maintain.
Dana: from sec: enforcement as close to data as possible is preferred to reduce accidental exposure. pushdown is ideal if authz model is stable.
Sam: tradeoffs summary:
- pushdown: fewer bytes transferred, stronger guarantees, requires index/infra work and changes to query planner
- app-filter: easier rollout, lower infra changes, but risk of partial-rollout exposure and higher cpu on app nodes
Proposal: hybrid rollout
1) authz-query gateway that attempts pushdown when model+indexes exist, falls back to app-filter otherwise
2) feature-flagged rollout by org to reduce blast radius
3) strict perf/regression metrics during rollout (tokenized by org size + panel complexity)
Sketch (example):
```sql
-- RBAC pushdown example
SELECT p.* FROM panels p
JOIN authz.allowed_resources ar ON ar.resource_id = p.id
WHERE ar.principal = :user_id
  AND p.org_id = :org_id
LIMIT 100
```
Sam: i'll open an RFC follow-up with the authz gateway interface, fallback semantics, and migration steps.
ops-bot: feature-flag created: `dashboard.authz.hybrid` (rollout started)
Maria: action items:
- @Lee: authz gateway API + proto (design doc)
- @Sam: perf targets, SLOs, and load test harness
- @Dana: threat model and audit hooks
- @Maria: rollout plan, feature flag gating, canary criteria
Lee: i can take the API doc. ETA end of week.
Dana: will start threat model doc today and ping infra for audit-log requirements.
Sam: thanks — i'll add canary perf benchmarks to the RFC and link to existing dashboard benchmarks.
Maria: cool. sync Thursday 10am to walk the RFC. :thumbsup:
